capital.evidence_quote: St. John's is the capital and chief port of Antigua and Barbuda

currency.evidence_quote: The Eastern Caribbean Dollar (XCD) is pegged to the USD at 2.70 XCD to 1 USD; USD is accepted everywhere

timezone.evidence_quote: Antigua and Barbuda operates on Atlantic Standard Time UTC-4 year-round without daylight saving

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage is 230V 60 Hz across Antigua and Barbuda

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The alternating frequency of the electrical grid is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Sockets generally accommodate North American Type A and Type B plugs (with some Type G in resorts)

sources.title: Royal Police Force of Antigua and Barbuda

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 or 999 for emergency police assistance throughout Antigua and Barbuda

sources.title: Mount St. John's Medical Centre Ambulance

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency ambulance dispatch is coordinated via 911 or +1 268 484-2700

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 911 or 462-0044 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency dispatch number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourism security liaison division operates at St. John's: +1 268 462-0125

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Antigua ve Barbuda son derece huzurlu bir Karayip tatil cennetidir; standart seyahat önlemleri yeterlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Antigua and Barbuda is a peaceful Caribbean destination; exercise normal travel precautions.
advisory_headline.de: Antigua und Barbuda ist ein sehr friedliches Reiseziel; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Антигуа и Барбуда — спокойный карибский курорт; действуют обычные меры предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Antigua y Barbuda es un destino caribeño sumamente pacífico; aplican precauciones normales.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Antigua reach approximately 36.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 68.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Digicel and Flow offer 4G tourist SIMs at V.C. Bird International Airport (ANU). Arriving passengers must submit the online immigration/customs declaration form prior to arrival. 365 beaches line Antigua's coastline.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Digital entry forms should be completed prior to boarding flights to Antigua

religion.value: Christianity (approx. 77%, predominantly Anglican, Seventh-day Adventist, Pentecostal, and Moravian)

sources.title: Statistics Division of Antigua and Barbuda

religion.evidence_quote: Christian traditions are deeply embedded in national holidays and church community life

festivals.value: Antigua Carnival (celebrating emancipation in late July/early August), Antigua Sailing Week (world-class regatta)
festivals.evidence_quote: Antigua Sailing Week in April and the 10-day summer Carnival are headline international spectacles

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Wearing camouflage patterns or military-style clothing is strictly illegal for civilians and tourists under national law. Topless sunbathing and nudism are prohibited on public beaches. US dollars are accepted everywhere alongside EC dollars.

sources.title: Royal Police Force of Antigua and Barbuda Notice

legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: It is an offence for any unauthorized person to wear clothing made of camouflage material

tipping.value: Tipping 10-15% is customary in restaurants when service charge is not included. Tipping baggage handlers ($1-2 per bag) and tour guides is standard practice.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10-15% tip is customary in dining establishments
